name: @antv/x6-react-shape
notes: Official React shape renderer for X6 v3. Peers are React >=18, React DOM >=18 and @antv/x6 ^3. Renders React components through foreignObject, so it is browser-only. Last npm release was 2025-11-27; the repository is active but this package is close to the 12-month maintenance boundary.
provenance_note: No npm attestation was found when these facts were collected.
